models.name: agg_customer_metrics
models.description: Aggregate table with historical customer metrics. Calculates gross and net Lifetime Value (LTV), first and last purchase dates, churn risk (segmented thresholds by person_type: 180 days for PJ, 240 days for PF), and dynamic ABC Curve classification based on revenue concentration. Grain: 1 row per customer.

columns.name: customer_id
columns.description: Natural key of the customer.

columns.name: first_purchase_date
columns.description: Date of the customer's very first order.

columns.name: last_purchase_date
columns.description: Date of the customer's most recent order.

columns.name: days_since_last_purchase
columns.description: Number of days elapsed between the last purchase and the current date.

columns.name: is_churn_risk
columns.description: Boolean flag indicating if the customer is at risk of churning, using segmented thresholds by person_type: PJ (corporate) customers are flagged after 180 days of inactivity (~3x median repurchase interval), PF (individual) customers after 240 days (~4x median repurchase interval).

columns.name: total_valid_orders
columns.description: Historical count of valid orders placed by the customer.

columns.name: lifetime_gross_revenue
columns.description: Total gross revenue generated by the customer over their entire lifecycle (LTV).

columns.name: returned_amount
columns.description: Total refunded amount across the customer's lifetime, on valid (non-canceled) orders.

columns.name: total_taxes
columns.description: Total ICMS + IPI taxes across the customer's lifetime, applied to the amount retained after returns.

columns.name: lifetime_net_revenue
columns.description: Lifetime revenue net of returns and taxes (lifetime_gross_revenue - returned_amount - total_taxes), usable for profit-based LTV analysis.

columns.name: abc_class
columns.description: Customer classification based on the ABC Curve (Pareto Principle). 'A' = top 80% of revenue, 'B' = next 15%, 'C' = bottom 5%.

columns.name: person_type
columns.description: Indicates whether the customer is an individual (PF) or a company (PJ). Brought from dim_customers.

columns.name: inferred_purchase_reason
columns.description: Proxy for the purchase reason based on the customer profile. 'Professional Use' for corporate entities (PJ) and 'Leisure' for individuals (PF).

models.name: agg_customer_monthly
models.description: Monthly aggregate table at the customer grain (Customer x Month). Built using a date spine cross-join to ensure every month since the customer's first purchase is represented, even if they made no purchases (zero-filled). Ideal for cohort analysis, Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR), and MoM retention charts.

columns.name: customer_monthly_sk
columns.description: Surrogate key for the aggregate, generated by hashing the customer_id and the reporting_month.

columns.name: customer_id
columns.description: Natural key for the customer.

columns.name: person_type
columns.description: Customer type (PF or PJ) brought in for easy slicing in BI tools.

columns.name: reporting_month
columns.description: The first day of the reporting month.

columns.name: total_valid_orders
columns.description: Count of paid or confirmed orders placed by the customer in this specific month. Zero if no orders were placed.

columns.name: monthly_revenue
columns.description: Total gross revenue (line_total) generated by the customer in this specific month. Zero if no orders were placed.

columns.name: last_purchase_at
columns.description: Timestamp of the latest purchase made within this specific month. Null if the customer made no purchases.

models.name: agg_product_performance
models.description: Aggregate table tracking product performance at a monthly grain. Calculates Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) based on standard cost, and the true Contribution Margin after deducting returns, taxes, and costs.

columns.name: performance_month
columns.description: The first day of the performance month (YYYY-MM-01).

columns.name: product_variant_id
columns.description: Natural key of the product variant.

columns.name: product_name
columns.description: Product display name.

columns.name: category_name
columns.description: Product business category.

columns.name: brand_name
columns.description: Brand name of the product.

columns.name: gross_quantity_sold
columns.description: Total quantity sold (excluding canceled orders).

columns.name: returned_quantity
columns.description: Total quantity returned by customers.

columns.name: net_quantity_sold
columns.description: Net quantity sold (Gross Quantity - Returned Quantity).

columns.name: gross_revenue
columns.description: Gross revenue from sales.

columns.name: returned_amount
columns.description: Total amount refunded for returns.

columns.name: total_taxes
columns.description: Total taxes (ICMS + IPI) calculated over the non-returned amount.

columns.name: total_cogs
columns.description: Cost of Goods Sold (CMV). Calculated as Net Quantity Sold multiplied by the product's standard cost_price.

columns.name: net_revenue
columns.description: Net Revenue (Gross Revenue - Returned Amount - Taxes).

columns.name: contribution_margin
columns.description: Real Contribution Margin (Net Revenue - COGS). This is the true profit before operational expenses.

models.name: agg_sales_daily
models.description: Aggregate table with daily sales metrics by channel. Contains gross revenue, returned amounts, taxes applied to the residual amount, net revenue, and order volumes. Grain: 1 row per Day (date_id) and Channel (channel).

columns.name: date_id

columns.name: channel
columns.description: Sales channel (e.g., ecommerce, physical store).

columns.name: gross_revenue
columns.description: Gross revenue from valid orders (excludes canceled ones).

columns.name: returned_amount
columns.description: Total refunded amount corresponding to items sold on this specific day.

columns.name: total_taxes
columns.description: Total taxes (ICMS + IPI) calculated exclusively over the residual amount (gross minus return).

columns.name: net_revenue
columns.description: Net revenue (Gross Revenue - Returned Amount - Total Taxes).

columns.name: valid_orders_volume
columns.description: Distinct count of valid orders.

columns.name: canceled_orders_volume
columns.description: Distinct count of canceled orders. Used for the Cancellation Rate metric.

columns.name: valid_items_volume

models.name: agg_sales_regional_category_daily

Designed specifically to support geographical and categorical filtering in BI dashboards without hitting the detailed fact table. Excludes order counts to prevent fan-out (double-counting) issues for multi-category orders.

models.name: dim_calendary
models.description: Calendar dimension built using dbt_utils.date_spine. Spans from 2020-01-01 up to the maximum ingestion date (or end of current year). The date range is contiguous by construction, with no gaps, so the table can be flagged as a date table in Power BI — a requirement for the Time Intelligence measures.

dim_calendary.description: Calendar dimension built using dbt_utils.date_spine. Spans from 2020-01-01 up to the maximum ingestion date (or end of current year). The date range is contiguous by construction, with no gaps, so the table can be flagged as a date table in Power BI — a requirement for the Time Intelligence measures.

dim_customer_addresses.description: Customer address dimension with historical versions for address changes. Captures address history at the address-level and exposes current and prior versions for SCD2 reporting.

dim_customers.description: Customer dimension — one record per customer, enriched with the primary address geography (city/state/country). Conformed dimension used by fct_sales.

dim_employees.description: Employee dimension — one record per employee, with role and home location. Conformed dimension used by fct_sales (salesperson) and future purchase facts (buyer).

dim_locations.description: Location dimension. Contains historical records for each warehouse or store location (SCD Type 2).

dim_products.description: Product dimension at variant grain. One record per sellable variant (SKU), with the corrected business category, brand, and reference measures (sale price, cost price, tax rates). Conformed dimension used by fct_sales.

dim_suppliers.description: Supplier dimension. Contains historical records for each supplier (SCD Type 2), used by fct_purchases for supplier reliability analysis.

fct_sales.description: Sales fact at order-item grain. One record per order item, with foreign keys to the dimensions and additive measures (quantity, prices, taxes).

int_products_categorized.description: One record per product, with the category corrected via the seed_category_fix mapping (product type -> canonical category). Products whose type is not mapped fall into 'Não Classificado' with is_categorized = false.

int_purchases_enriched.description: One record per goods receipt item, enriched with purchase order, supplier (point-in-time SCD2), location (point-in-time SCD2), currency-converted amounts (BRL), and delay/lead time measures. Feeds fct_purchases.

int_returns_enriched.description: One record per returned order item, enriched with its return header context (customer, location, status, reason, etc.). Reusable returns base grain that feeds the returns marts.

int_sales_enriched.description: One record per order item, enriched with its order header context (customer, salesperson, location, channel, status). Reusable sales base grain that feeds the sales marts.
